answer: Every accepted answer's embedding goes into a public vault; a new key whose text scores above 0.9 cosine to any vaulted entry is rejected and its 0.5 POA fee burned. A sybil forge can't reskin one draft across 100 keys, so it must buy 100 truly distinct essays each epoch: roughly 100 x 0.5 POA fees plus 100 model runs, against a gain capped near one honest slot once jurors flag the thin ones, a net loss. Paraphrases pooled in one lagoon of near-copies just drain.
